checks: Adviser output binds the exact current W27 dossier snapshot, current W16 ResearchRevision and current active M09 ResearchStepRecord
baseline must be a current Source, Document or SourceMaterial version in the exact research revision inputs; other object kinds and older versions are rejected
Claim, Evidence and W25 ClaimEvidenceAssessment versions must be current exact research-revision inputs; theme, specification, withdrawn bodies and stale M09/snapshot/revision are rejected
the listed W25 assessments must cover exactly the selected Claims and their Evidence union must equal the selected Evidence set; irrelevant or background-only records cannot ground B1
a bounded judgment requires at least one SUPPORTS assessment, while attention scope, conditions, unknowns and falsifiers remain explicit
the original author/original explanation is represented separately from the journal contribution
before and after understanding must differ, and the case-specific gain cannot merely relabel either contribution
at least one actual gap in the baseline explanation is required
the gain record states how changed evidence would affect the judgment and carries its remaining limits
a judgment explicitly distinguishes a specific action decision from no action decision
specific decisions need a decision maker, comparison basis and at least two unique complete options
each option records action, rationale, costs, beneficiaries, likely third-party response, adjustment/exit and observable effect
no-action judgment cannot carry invented options; role labels, self-scores and undeclared fields are rejected by strict contracts
BOUNDED_JUDGMENT submits READY_FOR_NEXT, CANDIDATE_EXPLANATION remains CANDIDATE, and LIMITATION_OR_UNKNOWN submits LIMITED rather than a content pass
manual outputs cannot carry model admission, configuration, operation or domain identity
admitted-model output requires an active W19 ADVISER/given-material scope at output time
the actual M10 MODEL OperationRequest must bind every judgment input, match the exact configuration and use MODEL_PROCESS
the operation must have a successful OperationReceipt recorded before the Adviser output; the output references that exact operation
the artifact remains role=B1 with facts_verified=false, causal_support=false, content_review_required=true and publication_authorized=false
combined output and M10 submission does not claim atomic adoption; an archive-only result after M10 failure is an unadopted deterministic attempt
an exact retry on the unchanged dossier basis reuses that attempt and completes M10, while a changed basis requires a new Adviser version/request
repeated completed requests return the existing admissible M10 result
current snapshots admit only the latest exact Adviser output and one matching artifact in the active M10
concurrent exact writers do not leave two active M10 records or overwrite a newer snapshot
upstream rework invalidates M10; a rebuilt B1 uses the prior M10 history record as parent and a new Adviser parent version
